title: Yellowed Velvety Algerian Starch Tagine
description: A pungent and velvety Algerian dish featuring starch, with a lacquer glaze, served in a bamboo tray, suitable for Jain-friendly diets.

ingredients.name: Tapioca starch
ingredients.notes: available at most health food stores

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is lightly browned, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tapioca starch, turmeric, and cumin, and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Gradually add 4 cups of water, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and season with salt to taste.
Transfer the tagine to a bamboo tray and serve hot.
